meta.title: German Driving Theory Mock Test – Class A, B, AB & Mofa | Abgefahrn
meta.description: Free online mock test for the German driving licence theory exam (Führerschein-Theorieprüfung). 6 languages, class A / B / AB / Mofa, picture and video questions just like TÜV and DEKRA.

home.headline: German driving theory — mock test online
home.subheadline: Practise the official German Führerschein theory exam in your language — for class A, B, A+B or Mofa.
home.cinemaHeadline: German Driving Theory — Mock Test Online
home.cinemaSubheadline: Practise the official German Führerschein theory exam for free in 6 languages — class A, B, A+B and Mofa. Over 250 original questions with picture and video items, just like the TÜV and DEKRA exam.
home.mascotSpeech: Ready? Let's get you behind the wheel.
home.infoTitle: How does the mock test work?
home.infoBody: Since 2008, the theoretical driving licence test in Germany has been conducted using a uniform system developed by TÜV and DEKRA. Our mock test mirrors that exam format so you can prepare realistically.

filter.heading: Practice by topic
filter.subheading: Pick a filter to drill a specific kind of question.

A.name: Class A
A.description: Motorcycles – large bikes with no power limit.

B.name: Class B
B.description: Cars up to 3.5 t and up to 8 passenger seats.

AB.name: Class A + B
AB.description: Motorcycle and car combined – the full programme.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: We couldn't load this question. This usually happens when an older session is stored in your browser after the app has been updated. Resetting will clear that and let you start a fresh test.

topics.title: Learn by topic
topics.subtitle: Pick a topic to drill down. Each topic links to the questions tagged with that catalogue code.

search.title: Search questions
search.subtitle: Type a word, phrase, or rule — we'll match against question text, answer options and explanations.

search.noResults: No matches. Try a different word.
